summary: A harness-prompt card's attention presentation carries its prompt: the call the harness names while it has no result in the seat's conversation, the answers st offers and whether a client may answer

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. presentation.prompt is already in the client contract.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The attention refresher now serves presentation.prompt on harness-prompt cards: the call prompt.respond names while it has no result (no call when none is named), its input cut at 4 KiB (and never allowed when the timeline holds only a preview of it), the offered answers and allow; or calls null with unknown_reason when st cannot read the seat's conversation on this node. Older clients ignore it.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Each prompt card that names a call reads the newest 256 entries of its seat's conversation when the attention list folds, through the conversation cache client reads share. The refresher follows each such conversation from before it reads it (a file watch on the transcript's directory, covering a SQLite source's write-ahead log) and presents the prompts again when one changes; a card whose conversation st cannot follow says so and offers no answer.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions; an older daemon serves no prompt and clients fall back to reading the conversation themselves.
